tools.name: get_assessment_questions
tools.description: Use first when someone wants to estimate the German care grade (Pflegegrad) or asks "wie viele Punkte", "welchen Pflegegrad bekommt meine Mutter", "Pflegegrad berechnen", "Pflegegrad einschätzen", "Begutachtung vorbereiten". Returns the questions of one of the six assessment areas (Modul 1 Mobilität

tools.name: calculate_pflegegrad
tools.description: Use after the questions from get_assessment_questions are answered (or when the user already knows the point values). Computes per area: sum of single points, level, weighted points (Anlage 2 zu § 15 SGB XI), the total (only the higher of areas 2 and 3 counts) and the resulting Pflegegrad with today

tools.name: get_pflegegrad_facts
tools.description: Use for any figure, deadline or procedure around the German Pflegegrad: Pflegegeld and other benefits per grade ("wie viel Pflegegeld bei Pflegegrad 3", "Entlastungsbetrag", "Pflegebox"), applying ("Pflegegrad beantragen", "wie lange dauert der Antrag"), deadlines, the assessment visit ("Begutachtun
